Write me a 3 paragraph story about a tiger who learns to cook biryani
10:50 AM

Sheru the tiger lived at the edge of a forest near Hyderabad, and every evening the smell of biryani drifted in from the village and made his stomach growl. One night he crept up to a kitchen window and watched an old cook named Amma layer rice and spices in a big pot. He was so curious that he forgot to be scary, and Amma, who feared nothing, simply handed him a ladle.

His first try was a disaster. He burnt the onions, dumped in a whole fistful of chillies, and lifted the lid so many times that the rice turned to mush. Amma laughed and taught him the secret: fry the onions slowly till golden, soak the rice, seal the pot with dough, and then wait. Waiting was the hardest part for a tiger, but Sheru sat on his paws and counted fireflies until the steam did its work.

When he finally opened the pot, the grains were long and fluffy, and the smell of saffron filled the whole forest. The deer, the monkeys and even the shy porcupine came to taste it, and nobody ran away from him that night. From then on, Sheru was known not as the fiercest animal in the jungle, but as the one who made the best biryani, and he never ate alone again.
